'''Creador''' is a [[private equity]] firm focused on growth capital investments in South and [[Southeast Asia]], primarily [[Malaysia]], [[India]], [[Indonesia]], [[Vietnam]], [[Singapore]], [[Thailand]] and the [[Philippines]].

Creador is headquartered in [[Malaysia]], with four additional offices in [[India]], [[Indonesia]], [[Vietnam]], and the [[Philippines]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.livemint.com/Companies/tzTM4FNru3B81mW9saEZKP/Creador-raises-250-mn-to-seal-two-Indonesian-deals.html|title=Creador raises $250 mn, to seal two Indonesian deals|first=Liz|last=Lee|date=9 September 2015|publisher=}}</ref>

Established in 2011 by Brahmal Vasudevan, the firm has raised $3.1billion of investor commitments across 6 private equity funds since inception.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=https://www.dealstreetasia.com/stories/creador-raises-500m-in-fund-iii-looking-towards-sri-lanka-and-ph-too-4652/|title=Creador raises $500m in Fund III, looking towards Sri Lanka and PH too|website=www.dealstreetasia.com|access-date=2017-11-14}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite news|url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/specials/emerging-entrepreneurs/creador-ii-exits-somany-ceramics/article9675523.ece|title=Creador II exits Somany Ceramics|date=2017-05-01|work=The Hindu Business Line|access-date=2017-11-14|language=en}}</ref>

The firm invests in 5 principle industries including [[consumer product|consumer]], [[retail]], [[financial services]], [[business services]], and [[healthcare industry|healthcare]].<ref name="auto">{{Cite news|url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/specials/emerging-entrepreneurs/flexible-investment-fast-returns-the-creador-way/article8897925.ece|title=Flexible investment, fast returns — the Creador way|last=Ramakrishnan|first=N|date=2016-07-25|work=The Hindu Business Line|access-date=2017-11-14|language=en}}</ref>

== Private Equity Firm ==
Established in 2011, Creador has raised a total of $3.1billion from leading endowments, fund of funds, pension funds, banks, insurance companies and family offices across the world.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/economy-policy/pe-firm-creador-plans-fresh-funds-worth-up-to-600-mn-for-india-se-asia-117111500767_1.html|title=PE firm Creador plans fresh funds worth up to $600 mn for India, SE Asia|last=Narasimhan|first=T. E.|date=2017-11-16|work=Business Standard India|access-date=2017-11-17}}</ref>

=== Creador I ===
Established in 2011, Creador closed its maiden fund, Creador I, at US$130 million. There were a total of seven investments made in this fund across Indonesia, Malaysia, and India.
{| class="wikitable"
!Investment
!Year
!Company Description

|Cholamandalam
|{{center|2012}}
|Cholamandalam is a pan-Indian composite financial services provider established in 1978 and is engaged in the business of providing vehicle financing, home equity financing, business financing, stock broking and distribution of financial products. Creador invested around Rs 106 crore in Cholamandalam in early 2012. Creador exited their investment in June 2016 and generated 5x returns in local currency terms.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.dealstreetasia.com/stories/creador-exits-from-cholamandalam-investment-sells-remaining-stake-for-32m-45317/|title=Creador exits from Cholamandalam Investment|website=www.dealstreetasia.com|access-date=2017-11-14}}</ref>
|-
|OldTown White Coffee
|{{center|2012}}
|OldTown is Malaysia Asian restaurant chain and in the coffee segment. Established in 1999, OldTown comprises two business segments: F&B restaurants and Retail ready-to-drink coffee. The group launched its restaurant business in 2005 and has over 200 outlets in Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, and China. Creador had invested $15 million in the company and has now fully exited this investment.<ref name="auto1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.thestar.com.my/business/business-news/2014/11/22/creators-of-value-creador-and-its-founder-stir-excitement-in-the-market/|title=Creador and its founder stir excitement in the market - Business News {{!}} The Star Online|website=www.thestar.com.my|access-date=2017-11-14}}</ref>

=== Creador II ===
Creador's second fund, Creador II closed at $331 million in 2014<ref name=":2"/> and the fund was fully deployed across 14 investments.<ref name="auto"/> Concurrently and in 2013, Creador established a dedicated operations and strategy team, known as Creador+.

extract:
Creador is a private equity firm focused on growth capital investments in South and Southeast Asia, primarily Malaysia, India, Indonesia, Vietnam, Singapore, Thailand and the Philippines.
Creador is headquartered in Malaysia, with four additional offices in India, Indonesia, Vietnam, and the Philippines.
Established in 2011 by Brahmal Vasudevan, the firm has raised $3.1billion of investor commitments across 6 private equity funds since inception.
The firm invests in 5 principle industries including consumer, retail, financial services, business services, and healthcare.
